domain: the vicfei dsh plugin family: multi-agent investment committees, quant research plugins, semantic layers, ontology construction for DeepSeek Harness

entity_types.name: dsh_plugin
entity_types.desc: A DeepSeek Harness plugin repository in the vicfei family, e.g. dsh-ai-hedge-fund, dsh-auto-ontology, dsh-CCXT, dsh-factor-auth.

entity_types.name: evidence_quote
entity_types.desc: A source quote attached to an entity or relation assertion; assertions without evidence are not persisted.

entity_types.name: evidence_store
entity_types.desc: The WeKnora evidence database queried with anchors to supply evidence for tickets.

entity_types.name: factor
entity_types.desc: A research factor hypothesis that may be enrolled into the strong-factor library only after passing all gates.

entity_types.name: falsification_counterexample
entity_types.desc: A recorded failed hypothesis archived in the counterexample library, making failure an organizational asset.

entity_types.name: gate
entity_types.desc: A code-enforced validation gate (G1 completeness, G2 data causality, G3 statistical significance, final review) that a ticket must pass.

entity_types.name: ic_memo
entity_types.desc: The auditable investment-committee memo output format carrying evidence-tagged claims and recorded dissent.

entity_types.name: investor_persona
entity_types.desc: A named investor archetype (Buffett, Munger, Lynch, Wood) that independently values a ticker within the hedge-fund committee.

entity_types.name: market_data_payload
entity_types.desc: A read-only market data record carrying its exchange and timestamp.

entity_types.name: ontology_assertion
entity_types.desc: An ABox entity or relation instance asserted per document, required to conform to the TBox.

entity_types.name: ontology_schema
entity_types.desc: The TBox type schema extracted from a corpus, constraining which instance types are admissible.

entity_types.name: portfolio_manager
entity_types.desc: The aggregating role that combines persona verdicts, names the deciding driver, and records dissent.

entity_types.name: research_ticket
entity_types.desc: A YAML research work order that is the admission unit for factor research.

entity_types.name: trading_guard
entity_types.desc: A code-level safety mechanism (triple-armed unlock, notional caps, symbol whitelist) that the LLM cannot bypass.

entity_types.name: upstream_project
entity_types.desc: An external open-source project that a plugin is built on or inspired by, such as ccxt, NVIDIA/auto-ontology, or virattt/ai-hedge-fund.

relation_types.name: built_on
relation_types.desc: A plugin is built on or implements the concept of an upstream project.

relation_types.name: sister_of
relation_types.desc: Two plugins belong to the same family and are cross-referenced as sister projects.

relation_types.name: aggregates_verdict_of
relation_types.desc: The PM combines the independent valuations of personas into a final verdict.

relation_types.name: produces
relation_types.desc: The hedge-fund plugin emits an IC-MEMO as its output.

relation_types.name: carries_evidence
relation_types.desc: An assertion is backed by a source quote; without one it does not land.

relation_types.name: conforms_to
relation_types.desc: An instance assertion must belong to a type declared in the TBox schema.

relation_types.name: extracted_from
relation_types.desc: The TBox schema is produced by the auto-ontology plugin's first pass over a corpus.

relation_types.name: submitted_as
relation_types.desc: A factor hypothesis enters the pipeline as a research ticket.

relation_types.name: gated_by
relation_types.desc: A ticket must pass each gate in sequence before enrollment.

relation_types.name: archived_in
relation_types.desc: A factor that fails a gate is archived as a falsification counterexample.

relation_types.name: enrolled_into
relation_types.desc: A factor passing all gates is enrolled into the strong-factor library.

relation_types.name: sourced_from
relation_types.desc: A ticket draws its evidence from the WeKnora evidence store.

relation_types.name: guards
relation_types.desc: The trading guard constrains order writes while read-only market data flows freely.
